title: Page 9
lines: 「少夫人，少主有交代，你一天必须喝个两壶山楂荷叶茶才行，那可以尽快消除你胸口的瘀塞之气。」小伶替她倒了杯茶，放在她面前。
这会儿裴璎珞像是认命了，也懒得开口纠正了，仍是低头吃饭。
「少夫人，有件事小伶想求你帮忙！」小伶突然在她脚旁跪了下来。
「小伶，你这是在做什么？」裴璎珞被她的举动吓到，连忙放下碗筷，起身将她扶起，为什么近来大家都喜欢向她下跪？
「少夫人，求求你救救我娘！我娘关在地牢已半个多月了。」小伶说着说着，突然哭了起来。
「小伶……你快别哭啊——有话好好说嘛！」这丫头何时变得跟秋月一样爱哭？连忙拉着她坐在一旁，以丝绢替她拭去脸上的泪水。
一旁的慕容莹脸上的笑容加深了。她这个未来的大嫂，果然一如她所想的不仅脾气好，心地也很善良，她喜欢。
「大嫂，事情是这样的……」慕容莹替哭得抽抽噎噎、话都说不清楚的小伶将韦大娘帮乔姥姥陷害她的事娓娓道来。
「既然这是慕容公子的决定，你们该求的人是他，你们求我也没有用啊。」裴璎珞不笨，一眼即看穿两人的打算。
「可是大嫂，大哥决定的事是不可能改变的，若是你开口．相信大哥一定会同意的。」姥姥就是最好的例子，若非大嫂的原因，大哥绝不会同意让姥姥回来。
「少夫人，我求求你帮帮忙好吗？」小伶哭着捉住她的手，求道。
「你们两个这不是存心为难我吗？」裴璎珞叹了口气，她现在一点也不想见到那个可恶的男人。
「小伶，你快别哭了，我大哥往这里来了。」慕容莹瞧见正步上石桥往这走来的慕容彻，连忙提醒仍在哭的小伶。
小伶慌忙拭去脸上的泪水，倏地起身站到一旁去。
见状，裴璎珞无奈地叹了口气，知道自己做不到见死不救，端起茶杯小口小口地啜饮，杏眸微敛沉吟着。
当慕容彻踏进亭内，目光即锁住正在喝茶的柔美人儿，俊脸上的笑容加深了。
「大哥，你来啦！用膳了没？」慕容莹开心地叫唤。
「还没。」慕容彻在裴璎珞身旁的石椅上落坐，瞧见她已吃了半碗饭，心下松了口气。
小伶连忙上前，为他盛饭递到他面前，这才又再退下。
「莹莹，你方才在陪你大嫂聊些什么？」慕容彻随口问。
「就聊些女孩子家的事嘛——大哥你问那么多做什么。」慕容莹笑着打哈哈。
裴璎珞在一旁听着兄妹俩的对话，心想这慕容莹也是个聪慧的姑娘。性情直爽，没有心机，加上笑口常开，她的笑容比起她大哥的要来得真诚也顺眼多了。
裴璎珞端起碗，吃了几口，又再停下。
「怎么了？不喜欢吃这糯米饭吗？」慕容彻关心地问。
裴璎珞并不理会他，杏眸对上小伶求助的目光，暗叹了口气，这才开口：
「小伶，我突然想吃韦大娘上回亲手作给我吃的那道枸杞炖鳗素菜汤，可以请她作给我吃吗？」
「可是我娘……」小伶吞吞吐吐，目光敬畏地看向慕容彻。
慕容彻注视着身旁人儿的娇颜，脸上的笑容有丝玩味。
「韦翰，既然少夫人想吃韦大娘亲手作的菜，还不快去叫韦大娘作出来。」
此话一出，韦家两兄妹同样一脸激动，欣喜异常，异口同声直道谢：
「多谢少主！多谢少夫人！」
韦翰明白少主会这么说，就代表同意放人了，身形迅速往地牢奔去。
「小伶，去灶房瞧瞧少夫人的药好了没。」慕容彻对着一旁高兴拭泪的丫头吩咐。
「是！我这就去。」小伶开心地离开。
「要不要再多添一碗饭？你瘦太多了，得多吃一点才行。」慕容彻见身旁人儿已吃完一碗饭，柔声轻问，欲再帮她添饭。
裴璎珞听而不闻，杏眸微敛，反倒拿起一旁的茶喝了起来。
慕容彻一点也不以为忤，脸上的笑容有抹宠溺，仍是帮她添了饭。
看着这一切的慕容莹忍不住窃窃低笑，看来大嫂果然是大哥的死穴。
在尚未见到大嫂之前，她就对大嫂印象不错，现在亲眼所见及相处后，更是深深喜欢上她了。光是她能让大哥改变决定，为她放低姿态这一点，她就十分佩服。
一大片红艳枫叶林中，三名女子正玩闹着，开心的笑声随风飘散。
「大嫂，快来捉我啊！」
「少夫人，我在这里！」
裴璎珞一双杏眸被黑布掩盖住，双手摸索着，耳边传来两道淘气的笑声，朱唇扬起一抹浅笑。
午睡过后，她即被慕容莹和小伶给硬拉来这片枫叶林，说是要玩捉鬼游戏，她猜拳轮了，只好当鬼。
「大嫂，我在左边！快过来捉我！」
「少夫人，我在你前面！」
裴璎珞双手在半空中摸索，突然耳边的笑声消失了，她正感疑惑时，指尖碰到温热的身体，她下意识地张开双臂抱住。
「捉到了。」
这一抱，她惊觉不对劲，莹莹和小伶的腰不可能这么粗，还有这结实的身躯……她忙不迭地想退开，纤腰却在下一刻被箝制住，令她动弹不得。她慌忙拉下遮住杏眸的黑布，布条一拉下，一张含笑俊脸正温柔地望着她。
「璎珞，这可是你这一个月以来主动靠近我，这一靠近就抱住我，可真令我受宠若惊啊！」戏谵地取笑她。
黑眸着迷地注视着她红润的小脸。这一个月来，她虽然对他视若无睹，可好在她并没有拿自己的身体赌气，该喝的药都喝了，身体才能恢复得那么快。
「慕容公子，还请放开我。」裴璎珞柔美小脸如罩寒霜，在他怀中挣扎。
她的话和蓄意隔出的疏离，令他脸上的笑容消失了，黑眸危险地眯起，一气之下更将她紧搂抱在怀里。
「够了！你这一个月以来对我视若无睹、冷漠以对、能避则避，若是避不过就是用现在这种冰冷疏离的表情面对我。你到底还打算气我多久，才肯原谅我？！」慕容彻气得在她耳畔低吼。
再也受不了她面对任何人都能温柔含笑以对，就连陷害她的姥姥和韦大娘都能得到她的宽恕，为何就是不肯原谅他？难道她对他再也没有感情了？
「要我原谅你可以，除非你让我离开灵山岛。和黎大哥之间的婚事是我亲口允诺的，我必须赶回去完婚。」裴璎珞俏脸沉凝，比起他的激动，显得异常冷静，语气平静地说出她的要求。
慕容彻俊脸阴沉，黑眸燃烧着怒火，放开对她的箝制，狠狠地瞪着她。
「你这辈子休想离开灵山岛！」狂吼地抛下这句话，为免盛怒中伤害到她，旋身拂袖离开。
慕容彻这一走，一旁的慕容莹和小伶吓得抚着胸口压惊。慕容莹走到裴璎珞面前，佩服地说：
「大嫂，看来你这次把大哥气得不轻，我从没见过大哥发那么大的火，就连发现姥姥设下圈套时都没气成这样。」
更让她佩服的是，大嫂竟然在面对大哥的怒气时，脸上一点惧意也没有。是真的不怕，还是笃定大哥绝不会伤害她？
「是你大哥做得太过分了。」裴璎珞垂眸，淡道。
「是是是——大哥的确是对大嫂太过分了。先是误会大嫂，后又将大嫂强掳来这里；不过，大嫂，我真心问你一句，你真的不喜欢大哥了吗？依我看来，你能轻易原谅姥姥和韦大娘，唯独无法原谅大哥，是因为你太重视他、太爱他，所以更无法原谅他对你的不信任和伤害，我说的可对？」慕容莹在她身旁绕了一圈，最后停在她面前，笑望着她说出自己的猜测。
content_en:
"Young madam, the young master has told you that you must drink two pots of hawthorn and lotus leaf tea a day, which can eliminate the congestion in your chest as soon as possible." Xiaoling poured a cup of tea for her and placed it in front of her.
At this moment, Pei Yingluo seemed to have accepted her fate and was too lazy to correct her. She still lowered her head to eat.
"Young Madam, there is something Xiaoling wants to ask you for help with!" Xiaoling suddenly knelt down at her feet.
"Xiao Ling, what are you doing?" Pei Yingluo was frightened by her actions. She quickly put down her bowls and chopsticks, stood up and helped her up. Why does everyone like to kneel to her recently?
"Young madam, please save my mother! My mother has been locked in the dungeon for more than half a month." Xiaoling said and suddenly started crying.
"Xiao Ling... please stop crying - you have something to say!" When did this girl become as crying as Qiuyue? He quickly pulled her to sit aside and wiped the tears from her face with silk.
一旁的慕容莹脸上的笑容加深了。 As expected, her future sister-in-law was not only good-tempered, but also kind-hearted as she expected. She liked her.
"Sister-in-law, this is what happened..." Murong Ying explained to Xiao Ling, who was crying so hard that she couldn't speak clearly, that Aunt Wei helped Grandma Qiao frame her.
"Since this is Young Master Murong's decision, he is the one you should beg for. There is no point in begging me." Pei Yingluo was not stupid and could see through the two people's plans at a glance.
"But sister-in-law, it's impossible to change what eldest brother has decided. If you ask, I believe eldest brother will definitely agree." Grandma is the best example. If it weren't for eldest sister-in-law, eldest brother would never agree to let grandma come back.
"Young madam, please help me, please?" Xiaoling cried, grabbing her hand and begging.
"Aren't you two trying to make things difficult for me?" Pei Yingluo sighed. She didn't want to see that hateful man at all now.
"Xiao Ling, please stop crying. My elder brother is coming here." Murong Ying saw Murong Che walking up the stone bridge and quickly reminded Xiao Ling who was still crying.
Xiaoling hurriedly wiped the tears from her face, stood up quickly and stood aside.
Seeing this, Pei Yingluo sighed helplessly, knowing that she couldn't do nothing to save her. She picked up the tea cup and took a sip, her almond-shaped eyes slightly narrowed and she pondered.
When Murong Che stepped into the pavilion, his eyes locked on the beautiful woman drinking tea, and the smile on his handsome face deepened.
"Brother, you're here! Have you eaten?" Murong Ying called happily.
"Not yet." Murong Che sat down on the stone chair next to Pei Yingluo, and he felt relieved when he saw that she had already eaten half a bowl of rice.
Xiaoling hurriedly stepped forward, served him a meal and handed it to him before stepping back again.
"Yingying, what were you talking about with your sister-in-law just now?" Murong Che asked casually.
"Let's just talk about some girl's family affairs - brother, why are you asking so many questions?" Murong Ying laughed and laughed.
Pei Yingluo listened to the conversation between the brother and sister and thought that Murong Ying was also a smart girl. She has a straightforward personality, no scheming, and always smiles. Her smile is more sincere and more pleasing to the eye than her elder brother's.
Pei Yingluo picked up the bowl, took a few bites, and then stopped.
"What's wrong? Don't you like eating this glutinous rice?" Murong Che asked with concern.
Pei Yingluo ignored him, her apricot eyes met Xiaoling's pleading eyes, she sighed secretly, and then spoke:
"Xiao Ling, I suddenly want to eat the wolfberry stewed eel vegetable soup that Aunt Wei made for me last time. Can you ask her to make it for me?"
"But my mother..." Xiaoling hesitated, looking at Murong Che in awe.
Murong Che looked at the beautiful face of the person next to him, with a playful smile on his face.
"Wickhan, since the young lady wants to eat the dishes cooked by Aunt Wei, why not go and ask Aunt Wei to cook them."
As soon as these words came out, the two brothers and sisters of the Wei family were equally excited and overjoyed, and they thanked each other in unison:
「多谢少主！多谢少夫人！」
Wickham understood that the young master would say this, which meant that he agreed to let him go, and he quickly ran towards the dungeon.
"Xiao Ling, go to the kitchen and see if the young lady's medicine is ready." Murong Che ordered the girl beside him who was happily wiping away his tears.
"Yes! I'll go right away." Xiaoling left happily.
"Would you like another bowl of rice? You've lost too much weight, so you need to eat more." Seeing that the person next to him had finished a bowl of rice, Murong Che asked softly, wanting to help her add more rice.
Pei Yingluo listened without hearing anything, her apricot eyes narrowed slightly, but she picked up the tea beside her and drank it.
Murong Che didn't feel dissatisfied at all, with a doting smile on his face, he still helped her to eat.
Murong Ying couldn't help but chuckle as she watched all this. It seemed that the sister-in-law was indeed the eldest brother's Achilles' heel.
She had a good impression of her sister-in-law before she met her, and now that she has seen and gotten along with her in person, she has fallen in love with her even more. She admired her very much just because she could make her eldest brother change his decision and lower his profile for her.
Chapter 10(2)
In a large forest of red maple leaves, three women were playing, their happy laughter drifting in the wind.
「大嫂，快来捉我啊！」
「少夫人，我在这里！」
Pei Yingluo's apricot eyes were covered by black cloth, and she was groping with her hands. Two naughty laughs came from her ears, and her red lips raised a slight smile.
After her nap, Murong Ying and Xiao Ling dragged her to the maple leaf forest, saying that they wanted to play a game of ghost hunting. She guessed the boxing wheel and had to play ghost.
「大嫂，我在左边！快过来捉我！」
「少夫人，我在你前面！」
Pei Yingluo groped with her hands in the air, and suddenly the laughter in her ears disappeared. When she was wondering, her fingertips touched the warm body, and she subconsciously opened her arms to hug him.
"Caught."
With this hug, she realized something was wrong. Yingying and Xiaoling's waists couldn't be so thick, and they had such strong bodies... She hurriedly tried to move away, but her slim waist was restrained the next moment, making her unable to move. She hurriedly pulled down the black cloth covering her apricot eyes. When the cloth was pulled down, a smiling handsome face was looking at her tenderly.
"Yingluo, this is the first time in the past month that you have taken the initiative to get close to me, and hugged me as soon as you got close. I'm really flattered!" He teased her playfully.
His dark eyes stared at her rosy little face with fascination. Although she had turned a blind eye to him in the past month, fortunately she did not take offense to her body. She drank all the medicine she needed, so that her body could recover so quickly.
"Mr. Murong, please let me go." Pei Yingluo struggled in his arms, her soft little face covered with frost.
Her words and deliberate alienation caused the smile on his face to disappear, his dark eyes narrowed dangerously, and he hugged her tightly in his arms in a fit of anger.
"That's enough! You have turned a blind eye to me for the past month, treated me coldly, and avoided me whenever you could. If you couldn't avoid it, you faced me with this cold and distant expression. How long are you going to stay angry with me before you forgive me?!" Murong Che roared in her ear in anger.
I can no longer bear it. She can face everyone with a gentle smile. Even the grandma and Aunt Wei who framed her can be forgiven by her. Why can't she forgive him? Does she have no feelings for him anymore?
"You can forgive me, unless you let me leave Lingshan Island. I personally promised the marriage to Brother Li, and I must rush back to consummate the marriage." Pei Yingluo's pretty face was serious, and she seemed unusually calm compared to his excitement, and spoke her request in a calm tone.
Murong Chejun's face was gloomy, and his black eyes were burning with anger. He released his grip on her and stared at her fiercely.
"You will never leave Lingshan Island in this life!" He threw these words away in a roar, and turned around to leave with a flourish of his sleeves to avoid hurting her in his rage.
When Murong Che left, Murong Ying and Xiao Ling beside them were so frightened that they touched their chests to suppress their shock. Murong Ying walked up to Pei Yingluo and said with admiration:
"Sister-in-law, it seems that you have made your eldest brother quite angry this time. I have never seen my eldest brother get so angry, not even when I found out that grandma set a trap."
What impressed her even more was that the sister-in-law showed no fear on her face when facing her elder brother's anger. Are you really not afraid, or are you sure that your eldest brother will never hurt her?
"Your elder brother went too far." Pei Yingluo lowered her eyes and said calmly.
"Yes, yes - eldest brother is indeed too much towards eldest sister-in-law. First he misunderstood eldest sister-in-law, and then he kidnapped eldest sister-in-law here. However, eldest sister-in-law, I sincerely ask you, do you really not like eldest brother? In my opinion, you can easily forgive grandma and Aunt Wei "The only reason you can't forgive your elder brother is because you value him too much and love him too much, so you can't forgive him for distrusting and hurting you. Am I right?" Murong Ying circled around her and finally stopped in front of her, smiling at her and telling her her guess.
